name: Shell-and-tube, plate and printed-circuit heat exchangers
aliases: Shell-and-tube, plate and printed-circuit heat exchangers
principle: Heat moves between two fluids across a wall. Shell-and-tube units suit high pressure and temperature, plate exchangers are compact, and plate-and-fin types are lighter. Counter-current flow is the most effective arrangement.

process_steps.name: Hot fluid enters one side of the exchanger
Heat transfers across tubes or plates

suppliers.name: Alfa Laval
suppliers.product: plate-and-frame and welded plate heat exchangers
